{\n399\t            let name: String = row.get(1)?;\n400\t            actual_columns.push(name);\n401\t        }\n402\t\n403\t        // Check that all expected br columns exist\n404\t        let mut all_present = true;\n405\t        for expected in &expected_br_columns {\n406\t            if !actual_columns.iter().any(|c| c == expected) {\n407\t                all_present = false;\n408\t                break;\n409\t            }\n410\t        }\n411\t\n412\t        // Check that there are no extra columns (br's rebuild_issues_table check)\n413\t        // bf adds `content_hash` which br doesn't have - this breaks forward compat\n414\t        if actual_columns.len() != expected_br_columns.len() {\n415\t            all_present = false;\n416\t        }\n417\t\n418\t        Ok(all_present)\n419\t    })\n420\t}\n421\t\n422\t/// Migrate from br's JSONL export, reconstructing events from git log.\n423\t///\n424\t/// This function:\n425\t/// 1. Reimports issues from issues.jsonl\n426\t/// 2. Reconstructs events by parsing git log --follow -p .beads/issues.jsonl\n427\t/// 3. Creates synthetic events for state transitions\n428\t/// 4. Optionally seeds velocity stats from reconstructed events\n429\tpub fn migrate_from_jsonl(workspace: &Path, seed_velocity: bool) -> Result<MigrateResult> {\n430\t    let beads_dir = find_beads_dir(workspace)\n431\t        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"No .beads directory found in {:?}\", workspace))?;\n432\t\n433\t    let metadata = load_metadata(&beads_dir)?;\n434\t    let config = load_config(&beads_dir)?;\n435\t    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n436\t    let jsonl_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.jsonl_export);\n437\t\n438\t    // Step 1: Import issues from JSONL (rebuilds issues table)\n439\t    let storage = Storage::open_with_config(&db_path, &config)?;\n440\t    let import_result = storage.sync_from_jsonl(&jsonl_path)?;\n441\t\n442\t    // Step 2: Reconstruct events from git log\n443\t    let events_reconstructed = reconstruct_events_from_git(&storage, workspace, &jsonl_path)?;\n444\t\n445\t    // Step 3: Seed velocity stats if requested\n446\t    if seed_velocity {\n447\t        seed_velocity_from_events(&storage)?;\n448\t    }\n449\t\n450\t    // Step 4: Verify migration\n451\t    let verification = verify_migration(&storage)?;\n452\t\n453\t    Ok(MigrateResult {\n454\t        verification,\n455\t        imported: import_result.imported,\n456\t        events_reconstructed,\n457\t    })\n458\t}\n459\t\n460\t/// Reconstruct events from git log history of issues.jsonl.\n461\t///\n462\t/// Parses git log to get the JSONL file state at each commit, then\n463\t/// creates synthetic events for state transitions:\n464\t/// - New bead appearing = synthetic created event\n465\t/// - Status open->in_progress = synthetic claimed event\n466\t/// - Status->closed = synthetic closed event with duration_seconds\n467\t///\n468\t/// All synthetic events get metadata.source=git-reconstructed annotation.\n469\tfn reconstruct_events_from_git(\n470\t    storage: &Storage,\n471\t    workspace: &Path,\n472\t    jsonl_path: &Path,\n473\t) -> Result<usize> {\n474\t    // Get snapshots from git log\n475\t    let snapshots = parse_git_log_snapshots(workspace, jsonl_path)?;\n476\t\n477\t    if snapshots.is_empty() {\n478\t        return Ok(0);\n479\t    }\n480\t\n481\t    let mut events_created = 0;\n482\t\n483\t    // Process snapshots chronologically (oldest to newest)\n484\t    for window in snapshots.windows(2) {\n485\t        let prev = &window[0];\n486\t        let curr = &window[1];\n487\t\n488\t        // Find differences between snapshots and create synthetic events\n489\t        for (issue_id, current_issue) in &curr.issues {\n490\t            let prev_issue = prev.issues.get(issue_id);\n491\t\n492\t            match prev_issue {\n493\t                None => {\n494\t                    // New bead appeared - create synthetic created event\n495\t                    insert_synthetic_event(\n496\t                        storage,\n497\t                        issue_id,\n498\t                        EventType::Created,\n499\t                        None,\n500\t                        None,\n501\t                        current_issue.created_at,\n502\t                    )?;\n503\t                    events_created += 1;\n504\t\n505\t                    // If already in_progress at creation, add claimed event\n506\t                    if current_issue.status == Status::InProgress {\n507\t                        insert_synthetic_event(\n508\t                            storage,\n509\t                            issue_id,\n510\t                            EventType::StatusChanged,\n511\t                            Some(Status::Open.as_str()),\n512\t                            Some(Status::InProgress.as_str()),\n513\t                            current_issue.created_at,\n514\t                        )?;\n515\t                        events_created += 1;\n516\t                    }\n517\t\n518\t                    // If already closed at creation, add closed event\n519\t                    if current_issue.status == Status::Closed {\n520\t                        insert_synthetic_event(\n521\t                            storage,\n522\t                            issue_id,\n523\t                            EventType::Closed,\n524\t                            None,\n525\t                            current_issue.close_reason.as_deref(),\n526\t                            current_issue.closed_at.unwrap_or(current_issue.created_at),\n527\t                        )?;\n528\t                        events_created += 1;\n529\t                    }\n530\t                }\n531\t                Some(previous_issue) => {\n532\t                    // Existing bead - check for status changes\n533\t                    if previous_issue.status != current_issue.status {\n534\t                        match (previous_issue.status.clone(), current_issue.status.clone()) {\n535\t                            (Status::Open, Status::InProgress) => {\n536\t                                // open -> in_progress = claimed\n537\t                                insert_synthetic_event(\n538\t                                    storage,\n539\t                                    issue_id,\n540\t                                    EventType::StatusChanged,\n541\t                                    Some(Status::Open.as_str()),\n542\t                                    Some(Status::InProgress.as_str()),\n543\t                                    curr.commit_date,\n544\t                                )?;\n545\t                                events_created += 1;\n546\t                            }\n547\t                            (_, Status::Closed) => {\n548\t                                // any -> closed = closed event\n549\t                                insert_synthetic_event(\n550\t                                    storage,\n551\t                                    issue_id,\n552\t                                    EventType::Closed,\n553\t                                    None,\n554\t                                    current_issue.close_reason.as_deref(),\n555\t                                    curr.commit_date,\n556\t                                )?;\n557\t                                events_created += 1;\n558\t                            }\n559\t                            _ => {\n560\t                                // Other status changes - generic status_changed event\n561\t                                insert_synthetic_event(\n562\t                                    storage,\n563\t                                    issue_id,\n564\t                                    EventType::StatusChanged,\n565\t                                    Some(previous_issue.status.as_str()),\n566\t                                    Some(current_issue.status.as_str()),\n567\t                                    curr.commit_date,\n568\t                                )?;\n569\t                                events_created += 1;\n570\t                            }\n571\t                        }\n572\t                    }\n573\t\n574\t                    // Check for assignee changes\n575\t                    if previous_issue.assignee != current_issue.assignee {\n576\t                        insert_synthetic_event(\n577\t                            storage,\n578\t                            issue_id,\n579\t                            EventType::AssigneeChanged,\n580\t                            previous_issue.assignee.as_deref(),\n581\t                            current_issue.assignee.as_deref(),\n582\t                            curr.commit_date,\n583\t                        )?;\n584\t                        events_created += 1;\n585\t                    }\n586\t\n587\t                    // Check for priority changes\n588\t                    if previous_issue.priority != current_issue.priority {\n589\t                        insert_synthetic_event(\n590\t                            storage,\n591\t                            issue_id,\n592\t                            EventType::PriorityChanged,\n593\t                            Some(&previous_issue.priority.0.to_string()),\n594\t                            Some(&current_issue.priority.0.to_string()),\n595\t                            curr.commit_date,\n596\t                        )?;\n597\t                        events_created += 1;\n598\t                    }\n599\t                }\n600\t            }\n601\t        }\n602\t\n603\t        // Check for deleted beads (tombstones)\n604\t        for issue_id in prev.issues.keys() {\n605\t            if !curr.issues.contains_key(issue_id) {\n606\t                // Bead was deleted - create synthetic deleted event\n607\t                insert_synthetic_event(\n608\t                    storage,\n609\t                    issue_id,\n610\t                    EventType::Deleted,\n611\t                    None,\n612\t                    None,\n613\t                    curr.commit_date,\n614\t                )?;\n615\t                events_created += 1;\n616\t            }\n617\t        }\n618\t    }\n619\t\n620\t    Ok(events_created)\n621\t}\n622\t\n623\t/// Insert a synthetic event with metadata.source=git-reconstructed.\n624\t///\n625\t/// Silently skips insertion if the issue doesn't exist (handles deleted beads\n626\t/// from git history gracefully).\n627\tfn insert_synthetic_event(\n628\t    storage: &Storage,\n629\t    issue_id: &str,\n630\t    event_type: EventType,\n631\t    old_value: Option<&str>,\n632\t    new_value:     )?;\n642\t\n643\t        if !exists {\n644\t            // Issue doesn't exist - likely deleted, skip event insertion\n645\t            return Ok(());\n646\t        }\n647\t\n648\t        tx.execute(\n649\t            \"INSERT INTO events (issue_id, event_type, actor, old_value, new_value, created_at)\n650\t             VALUES (?1, ?2, 'git-reconstructed', ?3, ?4, ?5)\",\n651\t            rusqlite::params![\n652\t                issue_id,\n653\t                event_type.as_str(),\n654\t                old_value,\n655\t                new_value,\n656\t                created_at.to_rfc3339()\n657\t            ],\n658\t        )?;\n659\t\n660\t        // Add annotation marking this as git-reconstructed\n661\t        tx.execute(\n662\t            \"INSERT OR IGNORE INTO bead_annotations (bead_id, key, value)\n663\t             VALUES (?1, 'metadata.source', 'git-reconstructed')\",\n664\t            rusqlite::params![issue_id],\n665\t        )?;\n666\t\n667\t        Ok(())\n668\t    })\n669\t}\n670\t\n671\t/// Parse git log to get snapshots of issues.jsonl at each commit.\n672\t///\n673\t/// Runs: git log --follow --date=iso-strict -- .beads/issues.jsonl\n674\t/// Then for each commit, runs: git show <commit>:path to get full contents\n675\tfn parse_git_log_snapshots(workspace: &Path, jsonl_path: &Path) -> Result<Vec<JsonlSnapshot>> {\n676\t    let relative_path = jsonl_path.strip_prefix(workspace).unwrap_or(jsonl_path);\n677\t    let path_str = relative_path.to_str().unwrap_or(\".beads/issues.jsonl\");\n678\t\n679\t    // First, get list of commits that touched this file\n680\t    let output = Command::new(\"git\")\n681\t        .args([\"log\", \"--follow\", \"--format=%H|%ci\", \"--\", path_str])\n682\t        .current_dir(workspace)\n683\t        .output()?;\n684\t\n685\t    if !output.status.success() {\n686\t        // Not in git repo or file has no history - return empty\n687\t        return Ok(Vec::new());\n688\t    }\n689\t\n690\t    let stdout = String::from_utf8(output.stdout)?;\n691\t    let mut snapshots = Vec::new();\n692\t\n693\t    // Parse each commit and get the file contents at that commit\n694\t    for line in stdout.lines() {\n695\t        let parts: Vec<&str> = line.splitn(2, '|').collect();\n696\t        if parts.len() != 2 {\n697\t            continue;\n698\t        }\n699\t\n700\t        let commit_hash = parts[0].to_string();\n701\t        let commit_date_str = parts[1];\n702\t\n703\t        // Parse the date (git log --format=%ci gives \"2024-01-01 12:00:00 +0000\")\n704\t        let commit_date = parse_git_date(commit_date_str)?;\n705\t\n706\t        // Get file contents at this commit\n707\t        let file_output = Command::new(\"git\")\n708\t            .args([\"show\", &format!(\"{}:{}\", commit_hash, path_str)])\n709\t            .current_dir(workspace)\n710\t            .output();\n711\t\n712\t        let issues = match file_output {\n713\t            Ok(out) if out.status.success() => {\n714\t                let content = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout);\n715\t                parse_jsonl_issues(&content)?\n716\t            }\n717\t            _ => {\n718\t                // File didn't exist at this commit (or was empty)\n719\t                HashMap::new()\n720\t            }\n721\t        };\n722\t\n723\t        snapshots.push(JsonlSnapshot {\n724\t            commit_hash,\n725\t            commit_date,\n726\t            issues,\n727\t        });\n728\t    }\n729\t\n730\t    // git log returns newest first, we want oldest first\n731\t    snapshots.reverse();\n732\t    Ok(snapshots)\n733\t}\n734\t\n735\t/// Parse git date format \"2024-01-01 12:00:00 +0000\" to DateTime<Utc>\n736\tfn parse_git_date(date_str: &str) -> Result<DateTime<Utc>> {\n737\t    use chrono::NaiveDateTime;\n738\t    // git log --format=%ci gives \"2024-01-01 12:00:00 +0000\"\n739\t    let trimmed = date_str.trim();\n740\t    // Parse \"YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS +ZZZZ\" format\n741\t    if let Ok(dt) = NaiveDateTime::parse_from_str(trimmed, \"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %z\") {\n742\t        return Ok(DateTime::from_naive_utc_and_offset(dt, Utc));\n743\t    }\n744\t\n745\t    // Fallback: try parsing as ISO-8601\n746\t    DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(trimmed)\n747\t        .map(|dt| dt.with_timezone(&Utc))\n748\t        .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!(\"Failed to parse git date: {}\", date_str))\n749\t}\n750\t\n751\t/// Parse JSONL content into a map of issues.\n752\tfn parse_jsonl_issues(content: &str) -> Result<HashMap<String, Issue>> {\n753\t    let mut issues = HashMap::new();\n754\t    for line in content.lines() {\n755\t        let line = line.trim();\n756\t        if line.is_empty() {\n757\t            continue;\n758\t        }\n759\t        if let Ok(issue) = serde_json::from_str::<Issue>(line) {\n760\t            issues.insert(issue.id.clone(), issue);\n761\t        }\n762\t    }\n763\t    Ok(issues)\n764\t}\n765\t\n766\t/// Parse a worker ID to extract model and harness information.\n767\t///\n768\t/// Worker IDs follow patterns like:\n769\t/// - \"worker-claude-sonnet-4-6-01\" → model=\"claude-sonnet-4-6\", harness=\"unknown\"\n770\t/// - \"worker-claude-opus-4-7-02\" → model=\"claude-opus-4-7\", harness=\"unknown\"\n771\t/// - \"claude-code-glm-4.7\" → model=\"claude-code-glm-4.7\", harness=\"unknown\"\n772\t///\n773\t/// Returns (model, harness) tuple.\n774\tfn parse_worker_actor(actor: &str) -> (String, String) {\n775\t    let actor_lower = actor.to_lowercase();\n776\t\n777\t    // Pattern: worker-{model}-{number}\n778\t    // e.g., \"worker-claude-sonnet-4-6-01\" → \"claude-sonnet-4-6\"\n779\t    if actor_lower.starts_with(\"worker-\") {\n780\t        let parts: Vec<&str> = actor_lower.split('-').collect();\n781\t        if parts.len() >= 3 {\n782\t            // Rejoin parts between \"worker\" and the final numeric suffix\n783\t            // e.g., [\"worker\", \"claude\", \"sonnet\", \"4\", \"6\", \"01\"]\n784\t            //      → model = \"claude-sonnet-4-6\", skip \"01\"\n785\t            let mut model_parts = Vec::new();\n786\t            for (i, part) in parts.iter().enumerate() {\n787\t                if i == 0 {\n788\t                    continue; // skip \"worker\"\n789\t                }\n790\t                // Check if this is a numeric suffix (like \"01\", \"02\")\n791\t                if i == parts.len() - 1 && part.parse::<u32>().is_ok() {\n792\t                    break; // Skip the trailing numeric suffix\n793\t                }\n794\t                model_parts.push(*part);\n795\t            }\n796\t            if !model_parts.is_empty() {\n797\t                return (model_parts.join(\"-\"), \"unknown\".to_string());\n798\t            }\n799\t        }\n800\t    }\n801\t\n802\t    // Pattern: {model}-{number} (e.g., \"claude-code-glm-4.7\")\n803\t    if actor_lower.contains(\"claude\") {\n804\t        // Extract the model name - everything up to a version-like pattern\n805\t        // or use the whole actor if no clear pattern\n806\t        return (actor_lower, \"unknown\".to_string());\n807\t    }\n808\t\n809\t    // Fallback: couldn't parse\n810\t    (\"unknown\".to_string(), \"unknown\".to_string())\n811\t}\n812\t\n813\t/// Seed velocity stats from reconstructed events.\n814\t///\n815\t/// Scans events table for closed events and populates Uses the actor field from events to infer model/harness.\n817\tpub fn seed_velocity_from_events(storage: &Storage) -> Result<()> {\n818\t    storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n819\t        // stmt.query([])?;\n832\t        let mut stats: HashMap<(String, String, String), Vec<i64>> = HashMap::new();\n833\t\n834\t        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n835\t            let _issue_id: DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&created_at)?.with_timezone(&Utc);\n843\t            let duration_secs = closed_dt.signed_duration_since(created_dt).num_seconds();\n844\t\n845\t            // Skip negative durations (data issues)\n846\t            if duration_secs < 0 {\n847\t                continue;\n848\t            }\n849\t\n850\t            // Parse actor to infer model and harness\n851\t            let (model, harness) = parse_worker_actor(&actor);\n852\t\n853\t            stats.entry((model, harness, issue_type))\n854\t                .or_default()\n855\t                .push(duration_secs);\n856\t        }\n857\t\n858\t        // Compute and insert stats\n859\t        for ((model, harness, issue_type), mut durations) in stats {\n860\t            if durations.is_empty() {\n861\t                continue;\n862\t            }\n863\t\n864\t            durations.sort_unstable();\n865\t            let count = durations.len();\n866\t            let p50_seconds = Some(durations[count / 2] as i32);\n867\t            let p90_idx = (count * 9 / 10).min(count - 1);\n868\t            let p90_seconds = Some(durations[p90_idx] as i32);\n869\t            let avg_seconds = Some(durations.iter().sum::<i64>() as f64 / count as f64);\n870\t\n871\t            tx.execute(\n872\t                \"INSERT OR REPLACE INTO velocity_stats (model, harness, issue_type, sample_count, p50_seconds, p90_seconds, avg_seconds, last_updated)\n873\t                 VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5, ?6, ?7, ?8)\",\n874\t                rusqlite::params![\n875\t                    model,\n876\t                    harness,\n877\t                    issue_type,\n878\t                    count as i32,\n879\t                    p50_seconds,\n880\t                    p90_seconds,\n881\t                    avg_seconds,\n882\t                    Utc::now().to_rfc3339()\n883\t                ],\n884\t            )?;\n885\t        }\n886\t\n887\t        Ok(())\n888\t    })\n889\t}\n890\t\n891\t/// Verify migration results.\n892\tfn verify_migration(storage: &Storage) -> Result<VerificationResult> {\n893\t    let mut errors = Vec::new();\n894\t\n895\t    // Check that issues were imported\n896\t    let count = storage.count_issues()?;\n897\t    if count == 0 {\n898\t        errors.push(\"No issues found in database after migration\".to_string());\n899\t    }\n900\t\n901\t    // Check for orphaned dependencies\n902\t    let issues = storage.list_all_issues()?;\n903\t    for issue in &issues {\n904\t        for dep in &issue.dependencies {\n905\t               \"Orphaned dependency: {} depends on non-existent {}\",\n909\t                    issue.id, dep.depends_on_id\n910\t                ));\n911\t            }\n912\t        }\n913\t    }\n914\t\n915\t    Ok(VerificationResult { errors })\n916\t}\n917\t\n918\t/// Migrate a br workspace to bf using Path B (explicit migration with backup and verification).\n919\t///\n920\t/// This is a convenience wrapper for the `migrate()` function that matches the naming\n921\t/// convention specified in Phase 4C of the implementation plan.\n922\t///\n923\t/// # Arguments\n924\t/// * `workspace_path` - Path to the workspace root directory\n925\t/// * `dry_run` - If true, print what would be done without making changes\n926\t/// * `skip_verify` - If true, skip forward/backward let relative_path = jsonl_path.strip_prefix(workspace).unwrap_or(jsonl_path);\n    let path_str = relative_path.to_str().unwrap_or(\".beads/issues.jsonl\");\n\n    // First, get list of commits that format)\n949\t    let annotation_filter = match annotation {\n950\t        Some(ref ann) => {\n951\t            let parts: Vec<&str> = ann.splitn(2, '=').collect();\n952\t            if parts.len() != 2 {\n953\t                return Err(anyhow!(\"Invalid annotation format. Use key=value\"));\n954\t            }\n955\t            Some((parts[0].to_string(), parts[1].to_string()))\n956\t        }\n957\t        None => None,\n958\t    };\n959\t\n960\t    let metadata =       filter.issue_type =\n975\t                Some(IssueType::from_str(t.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?);\n976\t        }\n977\t        filter.assignee = assignee.clone();\n978\t        filter.priority = priority;\n979\t        filter.annotation = annotation_filter.clone();\n980\t        // --limit 0 means unlimited\n981\t        filter.limit = limit.and_then(|l| if l == 0 { None } status_filter);\n990\t        }\n991\t        if let Some(ref t) = type_ {\n992\t            let type_filter = IssueType::from_str(t.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?;\n993\t            issues.retain(|i| i.issue_type == type_filter);\n994\t        }\n995\t        if let Some(ref assignee_val) = assignee {\n996\t            issues.retain(|i| i.assignee.as_deref() ==            });\n1007\t        }\n1008\t        // Apply limit\n1009\t        if let Some(l) = limit {\n1010\t            if l != 0 {\n1011\t                issues.truncate(l);\n1012\t            }\n1013\t        }\n1014\t    }\n1015\t\n1016\t    let output_format = OutputFormat::from_str(format).unwrap_or(OutputFormat::Text);\n1017\t    let formatter = get_formatter(output_format);\n1018\t    print!(\"{}\", formatter.format_issues(&issues));\n1019\t\n1020\t    Ok(())\n1021\t}\n1022\t\n1023\tfn cmd_show(beads_dir: &PathBuf, id: &str, format: &str) -> Result<()> {\n1024\t    let metadata = prefix: &str) -> Result<()> {\n    std::fs::create_dir_all(beads_dir)?;\n\n    let config_path = beads_dir.join(\"config.yaml\");\n    if !config_path.exists() {\n        let config = format!(\n            r#\"issue_prefixes: [{}]\ndefault_priority: 2\ndefault_type: task\nclaim_ttl_minutes: 30\n\"#,\n            prefix\n        );\n        std::fs::write(&config_path, config)?;\n    }\n\n    let metadata_path = beads_dir.join(\"metadata.json\");\n    if !metadata_path.exists() {\n        let metadata = r#\"{\"database\": \"beads.db\", \"jsonl_export\": \"issues.jsonl\"}\"#;\n        std::fs::write(&metadata_path, metadata)?;\n    }\n\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(\"beads.db\");\n    let _storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let gitignore_path = bead-forge workspace in {:?}\", beads_dir);\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_create(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    title: String,\n    type_: String,\n    priority: i32,\n    description: Option<String>,\n    assignee: Option<String>,\n    labels: Vec<String>,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = load_config(beads_dir)?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open_with_config(&db_path, &config)?;\n\n    let count = storage.count_issues()?;\n    let prefix = get_default_prefix(&config);\n    let id = crate::id::generate_id(prefix, count);\n\n    let mut issue = Issue::new(id.clone(), title, \".\".to_string());\n    issue.issue_type = IssueType::from_str(type_.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?;\n    issue.priority = Priority(priority);\n    issue.description = description;\n    issue.assignee = assignee;\n    issue.labels = labels;\n\n    storage.create_issue(&issue)?;\n\n    println!(\"{}\", id);\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_list(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    status: Option<String>,\n    type_: Option<String>,\n    assignee: Option<String>,\n    priority: Option<i32>,\n    annotation: Option<String>,\n    limit: Option<usize>,\n    all: bool,\n    format: &str,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    // Parse annotation filter (key=value format)\n    let annotation_filter = match annotation {\n        Some(ref ann) => {\n            let parts: Vec<&str> = ann.splitn(2, '=').collect();\n            if parts.len() != 2 {\n                return Err(anyhow!(\"Invalid annotation format. Use key=value\"));\n            }\n            Some((parts[0].to_string(), parts[1].to_string()))\n        }\n        None => None,\n    };\n\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let mut issues = if all {\n        // Include archived beads\n        list_all_with_archives(beads_dir)?\n    } else {\n        // Only from database\n        let mut filter = IssueFilter::default();\n        if let Some(ref s) = status {\n            filter.status = Some(Status::from_str(s.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?);\n        }\n        if let Some(ref t) = type_ {\n            filter.issue_type =\n                Some(IssueType::from_str(t.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?);\n        }\n        filter.assignee = assignee.clone();\n        filter.priority = priority;\n        filter.annotation = annotation_filter.clone();\n        // --limit 0 means unlimited\n        filter.limit = limit.and_then(|l| if l == 0 { None } else { Some(l) });\n        storage.list_issues(&filter)?\n    };\n\n    // Apply additional filters for --all mode (since we're not using DB filters)\n    if all {\n        if let Some(ref s) = status {\n            let status_filter = Status::from_str(s.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?;\n            issues.retain(|i| i.status == status_filter);\n        }\n        if let Some(ref t) = type_ {\n            let type_filter = IssueType::from_str(t.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?;\n            issues.retain(|i| i.issue_type == type_filter);\n        }\n        if let Some(ref assignee_val) = assignee {\n            issues.retain(|i| i.assignee.as_deref() == Some(assignee_val));\n        }\n        if let Some(p) = priority {\n            issues.retain(|i| i.priority.0 == p);\n        }\n        if let Some((ref key, ref value)) = annotation_filter {\n            issues.retain(|i| {\n                i.annotations\n                    .get(key)\n                    .map_or(false, |v| v == value)\n            });\n        }\n        // Apply limit\n        if let Some(l) = limit {\n            if l != 0 {\n                issues.truncate(l);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    let output_format = OutputFormat::from_str(format).unwrap_or(OutputFormat::Text);\n    let formatter = get_formatter(output_format);\n    print!(\"{}\", formatter.format_issues(&issues));\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_show(beads_dir: &PathBuf, id: &str, format: &str) -> Result<()> {\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let issue = match storage.get_issue(id)? {\n        Some(i) => i,\n        None => {\n            // Search archives\n            find_bead_in_archives(beads_dir, id)?\n                .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"Bead not found: {}\", id))?\n        }\n    };\n\n    match format {\n        \"json\" => {\n            // Strip dependencies/comments before serializing: NEEDLE's BrDependency\n            // format ({id, title, status, priority, dependency_type}) differs from\n            // bead-forge's Dependency format ({issue_id, depends_on_id, type, ...}).\n            // NEEDLE has #[serde(default)] on the deps field so empty is fine.\n            let mut out = issue;\n            out.dependencies = vec![];\n            out.comments = vec![];\n            // Wrap in array so NEEDLE's parse_single_bead (Vec<Bead> → first) works.\n            println!(\"{}\", serde_json::to_string(&vec![out])?);\n        }\n        \"toon\" => {\n            println!(\"ID: {}\", issue.id);\n            println!(\"Title: {}\", issue.title);\n            println!(\"Status: {}\", issue.status);\n            println!(\"Priority: {}\", issue.priority);\n            println!(\"Type: {}\", issue.issue_type);\n            if let Some(desc) = &issue.description {\n                println!(\"Description: {}\", desc);\n            }\n            if let Some(assignee) = &issue.assignee {\n                println!(\"Assignee: {}\", assignee);\n            }\n            if !issue.labels.is_empty() {\n                println!(\"Labels: {}\", issue.labels.join(\", \"));\n            }\n        }\n        _ => {\n            println!(\"ID: {}\", issue.id);\n            println!(\"Title: {}\", issue.title);\n            println!(\"Status: {}\", issue.status);\n            println!(\"Priority: {}\", issue.priority);\n            println!(\"Type: {}\", issue.issue_type);\n            if let Some(desc) = &issue.description {\n                println!(\"Description: {}\", desc);\n            }\n            if let Some(assignee) = &issue.assignee {\n                println!(\"Assignee: {}\", assignee);\n            }\n            if !issue.labels.is_empty() {\n                println!(\"Labels: {}\", issue.labels.join(\", \"));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_update(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    id: &str,\n    title: Option<String>,\n    status: Option<String>,\n    priority: Option<i32>,\n    assignee: Option<String>,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = load_config(beads_dir)?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open_with_config(&db_path, &config)?;\n\n    let changes = IssueChanges {\n        title,\n        status: status.map(|s| Status::from_str(&s).ok()).flatten(),\n        priority,\n        assignee,\n        ..Default::default()\n    };\n\n    storage.update_issue(id, cmd_reopen(beads_dir: &PathBuf, id: &str) -> Result<()> {\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = println!(\"Reopened bead {}\", id);\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_delete(beads_dir: &PathBuf, id: &str) -> Result<()> {\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path =     Ok(())\n    })?;\n\n    println!(\"Deleted bead {}\", id);\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_ready(beads_dir: &PathBuf, limit: usize, format: &str) -> Result<()> {\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let candidates = storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| get_ready_candidates(tx, limit, None, None))?;\n\n    match format {\n        \"json\" => {\n            for candidate in candidates {\n                println!(\"{}\", serde_json::to_string(&candidate)?);\n            }\n        }\n        \"toon\" => {\n            for candidate in candidates {\n                println!(\n                    \"{}\",\n                    crate::format::toon::format_ready_bead(\n                        &candidate.id,\n                        &candidate.title,\n                        candidate.priority,\n                        candidate.downstream_impact,\n                        candidate.critical_float,\n                    )\n                );\n            }\n        }\n        _ => {\n            for candidate in candidates {\n                println!(\n                    \"[{}] {} (priority={}, impact={}, float={})\",\n                    candidate.id,\n                    candidate.title,\n                    candidate.priority,\n                    candidate.downstream_impact,\n                    candidate.critical_float\n                );\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_claim(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    assignee: &str,\n    model: Option<String>,\n    harness: Option<String>,\n    harness_version: Option<String>,\n    any: bool,\n    fallback: Option<&str>,\n    workspace_paths: &[PathBuf],\n    dry_run: bool,\n    format: &str,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = load_config(beads_dir)?;\n    let claim_ttl = config.claim_ttl_minutes;\n\n    // Build worker metadata\n    let worker_metadata = WorkerMetadata {\n        worker_id: assignee.to_string(),\n        model: model.clone(),\n        harness: harness.clone(),\n        harness_version: harness_version.clone(),\n    };\n\n    if dry_run {\n        // Dry run mode - show what would be claimed\n        let candidates: Vec<(PathBuf, crate::claim::ScoredBead)> = if any || fallback == Some(\"any\")\n        {\n            // Multi-workspace dry run\n            let paths = if workspace_paths.is_empty() {\n                // Auto-discover workspaces from current directory\n                find_workspaces(&std::env::current_dir()?)?\n            } else {\n                workspace_paths.to_vec()\n            };\n\n            let mut all_candidates = Vec::new();\n            for path in &paths {\n                let local_beads_dir = path.join(\".beads\");\n                if local_beads_dir.exists() {\n                    let local_metadata = match load_metadata(&local_beads_dir) {\n                        Ok(m) => m,\n                        Err(_) => continue,\n                    };\n                    let local_db_path =    if nodes.is_empty() {\n        println!(\"  (no dependencies)\");\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    // Status indicators: ●=open, ◐=in_progress, ○=closed/blocked/deferred, ⊘=tombstone\n    let status_symbol = |status: &str| -> char {\n        match status {\n            \"open\" => '●',\n            \"in_progress\" => '◐',\n            \"closed\" => '○',\n            \"blocked\" => '◌',\n            \"deferred\" => '○',\n            \"tombstone\" => '⊘',\n            _ => '○',\n        }\n    };\n\n    for (i, node) in nodes.iter().enumerate() {\n        let is_cycle = node.path.contains(\"[CYCLE]\");\n\n        // Build tree prefix with proper branching\n        let mut prefix = String::new();\n        if node.depth > 0 {\n            for d in 0..node.depth as usize {\n                if d < node.depth as usize - 1 {\n                    prefix.push_str(\"│   \");\n                } else {\n                    // Check if this is the last node at this depth\n                    let is_last = nodes\n                        .iter()\n                        .skip(i + 1)\n                        .all(|n| n.depth < node.depth || (n.depth == node.depth && n.id > node.id));\n                    if is_last {\n                        prefix.push_str(\"└── \");\n                    } else {\n                        prefix.push_str(\"├── \");\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Truncate title if too long\n        let title = if node.title.len() > 60 {\n            format!(\"{}...\", &node.title[..57])\n        } else {\n            node.title.clone()\n        };\n\n        let cycle_mark = if is_cycle { \" [CYCLE]\" } else { \"\" };\n        let dep_type_str = node.dep_type.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"blocks\");\n\n        println!(\n            \"{}[{}] {} {} (P{}, {}){}\",\n            prefix,\n            node.id,\n            status_symbol(&node.status),\n            title,\n            node.priority,\n            dep_type_str,\n            cycle_mark\n        );\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_dep(beads_dir: &PathBuf, dep: DepCommands) -> Result<()>
